news.title: Ether, solana and dogecoin slide as Strategy's bitcoin sales plan pressures market
news.summary: Bitcoin held below $60,000 as a surging dollar kept crypto pinned. Onchain demand stayed quiet through the week's losses, and Strategy's plan to possibly sell bitcoin added to the caution.

news.title: Dubai set for crypto firm influx as MiCA deadline pushes companies to reassess Europe
news.summary: Dubai lawyer Irina Heaver says European founders are flocking to the UAE for faster licensing, a dedicated crypto regulator and access to markets beyond Europe.

news.title: Live updates: BlackRock's IBIT sheds $300 million as bitcoin demand dwindles
news.summary: IBIT alone shed $300 million while smaller funds absorbed some of the outflow. The selloff lands as the same AI trade that crashed Korea a week ago now powers a record quarterly rally there.

news.title: Bitcoin's correlation with dollar-yen rate hits -0.90, undercutting 'carry trade' theory
news.summary: Bitcoin’s price has shown an unusually strong negative 52-week correlation with the dollar-yen exchange rate.

news.title: SEC wins $5.5 million default judgment over alleged fake crypto platform NanoBit
news.summary: The group built trust via WhatsApp, then misappropriated user funds to Hong Kong bank accounts instead of executing any actual crypto trades.

news.title: Strategy heads for eleventh losing month in twelve as bitcoin weakness continues
news.summary: Strategy (MSTR) shares have lost around 41% of their value in June.

news.title: Bitcoin nears 2024 lows as options traders pay up for downside protection
news.summary: Bitcoin and ether slid toward key support price levels. DeFi tokens were hit hardest, even as XLM and LIT bucked the broader market weakness.

news.summary: Gain insight on Experian, SoFi Technologies and more in the latest Market Talks covering Financial Services.

news.title: Stocks Sink in Broad AI Rout Sparked by China's DeepSeek
news.summary: U.S. stocks were mostly lower, with the Nasdaq leading declines as makers of AI infrastructure suffered steep falls, many in the double digits. Nvidia was down 16%.
